# ACK controllers: checked source configuration

This Space keeps the checked ack controllers configuration used by the EKS inference example. It is the unchanged starting point for later environments.

Start here when you open this Space in Hub. This page explains the problem this example is meant to show, what to inspect, why it matters, and where the evidence lives.

## Why this example exists

This component installs the AWS controllers and CRDs that let Kubernetes objects create EC2, IAM, and EKS resources.

The source stays separate from environment settings, so a reviewer can see exactly what ConfigHub changes later.

## What this example shows

- The exact public source is `oci://ghcr.io/confighub/configs/eks-inference/ack-controllers@sha256:7f318e6448a35ac89cc465e476f9c73dcbde73dc213b7e13746ac01864a67566`.
- 7 ConfigHub Units hold the Kubernetes configuration for this component.
- The source is a Helm chart. Its output is retained as exact Kubernetes objects. Delivery must also handle installing CRDs before the objects that use them.
- This component belongs in the management cluster. It is step 1 for that part of the installation.
